key: neurips2025/MATCH_Multi-faceted Adaptive Topo-Consistency for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation.pdf
path: neurips2025/MATCH_Multi-faceted Adaptive Topo-Consistency for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation.pdf
title: MATCH: Multi-faceted Adaptive Topo-Consistency for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
one_line: MATCH通过双层次拓扑一致性提升半监督组织病理分割
innovations: 双层次拓扑一致性机制
method_framework: 基于教师-学生框架，结合MC dropout和时间训练快照，通过空间重叠、拓扑持久性和空间邻近性进行拓扑特征匹配，实现双层次拓扑一致性约束
experiment_framework: 在CRAG、GlaS和MoNuSeg三个组织病理学数据集上评估，使用10%和20%标记数据设置，比较Dice_obj、Betti Error、BME和DIU等指标
takeaways: 拓扑一致性可自然产生不确定性估计
空间与拓扑特征结合的匹配算法优于传统方法
